headline: School bus torched, multiple crude bombs explode across Dhaka; three arrested
summary: A school bus was set ablaze in Bhatara, while several crude bomb explosions rocked various parts of Dhaka, including Dhaka University, Mirpur, and near CID headquarters. Police have arrested three individuals in connection with the incidents.
details: A school bus belonging to Jalsiri Cantonment School and College was set on fire by miscreants in the Bhatara area of Dhaka. The bus was parked on the roadside when the incident occurred.
Concurrently, several crude bomb explosions were reported across the capital. Sounds of explosions were heard in multiple locations within the Dhaka University area.
Further explosions occurred in front of Pallabi Police Station, near Sony Hall in Mirpur-1, and in front of the CID headquarters in Malibagh. These incidents contributed to widespread concern.

Following the explosions at Dhaka University, three individuals were detained from the university area in connection with the incidents. Investigations are ongoing to determine the perpetrators and motives.

Further explosions occurred in front of Pallabi Police Station, near Sony Hall in Mirpur-1, and in front of the CID headquarters in Malibagh. These incidents contributed to widespread concern.

Following the explosions at Dhaka University, three individuals were detained from the university area in connection with the incidents. Investigations are ongoing to determine the perpetrators and motives.

headline_marked: [[Jubo Dal leader found dead]] in Bandarban stream with injury marks; police investigating
headline: Jubo Dal leader found dead in Bandarban stream with injury marks; police investigating
summary: The body of Md Sharif, joint convener of Talukdar Para block Jubo Dal, was recovered from a hilly stream yesterday morning. Police reported injury marks on his body, and an investigation is underway.
details: The body of Md Sharif, 33, a local leader of Jatiyatabadi Jubo Dal, was recovered from a hilly stream in Bandarban town yesterday morning. Sharif was the joint convener of the Talukdar Para block under Ward-9 of the Bandarban municipality unit of Jubo Dal.

Locals discovered the body floating in the stream near the Bandarban bus terminal around 10:00 AM while collecting water. Police and fire service personnel responded to the scene and retrieved the body.

Bandarban Sadar Police Station's Officer-in-Charge, Masud Parvez, stated that Sharif's body had injury marks on his hands, legs, and head, along with bleeding from his nose and mouth. Police are investigating whether he fell or was pushed down the hill.
caption:
A local Jubo Dal leader, Md Sharif, 33, was found dead in a stream in Bandarban with visible injury marks. Police have launched an investigation into the circumstances surrounding his death.

The body of Md Sharif, 33, a local leader of Jatiyatabadi Jubo Dal, was recovered from a hilly stream in Bandarban town yesterday morning. Sharif was the joint convener of the Talukdar Para block under Ward-9 of the Bandarban municipality unit of Jubo Dal.

Locals discovered the body floating in the stream near the Bandarban bus terminal around 10:00 AM while collecting water. Police and fire service personnel responded to the scene and retrieved the body.

Bandarban Sadar Police Station's Officer-in-Charge, Masud Parvez, stated that Sharif's body had injury marks on his hands, legs, and head, along with bleeding from his nose and mouth. Police are investigating whether he fell or was pushed down the hill.
